title: Document event logging schema
description: Document the product event taxonomy so every team logs the same way. ## Problem Three teams invented three naming styles; funnels break every other sprint. ## Proposed Convention Use object_action names with snake_case payload keys. | Good | Bad | | --- | --- | | ticket_created | CreateTicket | | branch_merged | mergedBranch | | comment_submitted | new-comment | ## Tasks - [x] Collect current events from staging - [ ] Review naming with data engineering - [ ] Publish examples in handbook - [ ] Add linter warning for off-spec names > Keep the handbook page under two screens or teams will ignore it.
